title: runtime-function-call-spec: canonical JSON parameter schema and validation error taxonomy
creator: Anya Patel
description: Define a canonical JSON schema subset and server-side validation + error message contract for runtime function/tool calling. Goals: robust developer ergonomics for SDK users, deterministic machine-readable errors for automated retries/fallbacks, and a compatibility mode to preserve existing callers while migrating to stricter validation.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical schema dialect is documented (recommended subset of JSON Schema) and published in the schema registry
Server compiles and caches user-provided function schemas; invalid schemas rejected with clear error codes
Runtime validation rejects or warns on invalid parameters according to tenant-configured compatibility policy
SDKs (JS/Python) receive a structured ValidationError with: error_code, human_message, parameter_path, schema_path, and suggested_action
Telemetry: validation failure counters + histogram of error_code per function + example failing payload sampled to debug store (PII redacted)
work_notes: 2026-03-10 — Kickoff: confirmed scope with PM and DX. Decided to standardize on a small JSON Schema subset to avoid heavy $ref/remote resolution problems.
2026-03-11 — Spike: compiled sample function schemas from public customers. Found ~8% of schemas use additionalProperties:true; will require compatibility policy rather than forced rejection.

2026-03-12 — Decision: adopt JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 subset with support for types, properties, required, enum, pattern, min/max, format (date-time, uri, email), and local $defs only. Disallow remote $ref and complex constructs (if/then/else, unevaluatedProperties).

2026-03-12 — Trade-off: strict additionalProperties:false by default to avoid silent misspellings, but offer tenant-level 'compatibility_mode=warn' to accept extra fields and emit FUNC_CALL_COMPAT_WARNING entries.

2026-03-12 — Error taxonomy drafted (see artifacts link). Added machine-friendly codes (FUNC_CALL_INVALID_TYPE, FUNC_CALL_MISSING_REQUIRED, FUNC_CALL_EXTRA_PARAM, FUNC_CALL_PATTERN_MISMATCH, FUNC_CALL_ENUM_MISMATCH, FUNC_CALL_OUT_OF_RANGE, FUNC_CALL_SCHEMA_INVALID, FUNC_CALL_COMPAT_WARNING).

2026-03-13 — Implementation notes: validator will compile schemas at creation time and cache a serialized validator. Runtime path extraction will use JSON Pointer to reference offending fields. SDKs to map validation errors to typed exceptions. Backend will return HTTP 400 for hard validation failures and HTTP 422 for schema-invalid submissions (to differentiate).

Open: need to coordinate with Console team for schema registry UI (PRD ticket PM-4122). Also schedule a security review for sampled payload retention and PII redaction (security_review_required=true).
notes_for_engineering: Implement a lightweight compile-time check for schema features we don't support. Provide a 'compatibility_mode' flag on function registration: 'strict' (reject extra fields), 'warn' (accept but emit FUNC_CALL_COMPAT_WARNING), 'coerce' (best-effort type coercion — opt-in per tenant). Coercion is dangerous and disabled by default.
error_contract_examples: Type mismatch example (HTTP 400): {"error_code": "FUNC_CALL_INVALID_TYPE", "message": "Expected integer for 'count' but got string", "parameter_path": "/options/count", "expected": "integer", "received": "string"}

Compatibility warning (HTTP 200 + warnings field): {"result": {...}, "warnings": [{"error_code": "FUNC_CALL_COMPAT_WARNING", "message": "Received unexpected field 'legacy_flag' — accepted under tenant compatibility policy", "parameter_path": "/legacy_flag"}]}

Invalid schema on registration (HTTP 422): {"error_code": "FUNC_CALL_SCHEMA_INVALID", "message": "Schema contains unsupported keyword 'unevaluatedProperties'", "schema_path": "#/unevaluatedProperties"}
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): implement schema compile-time checks and server-side validator, expose schema registration API changes, and return machine-friendly error codes for hard failures.
Phase 2 (1 week): add compatibility_mode=warn and telemetry counters. Wire SDKs to surface structured ValidationError and warnings in console.
Phase 3 (2 weeks): Default new tenants to strict mode; existing tenants default to warn for 30 days, then auto-upgrade if no failures. Communicate via dashboard + email.
follow_ups: DX: Add sample schema templates and a schema linter plugin for editors
Observability: dashboard for top 20 error codes per tenant and sampling config for failing payloads
Security: finalize PII redaction rules for sampled payloads and approve retention policy
